reviews.title: You can’t go wrong for the price.
reviews.comment: I used this for my ps5. It was easy to install, however it didn’t come with a heat sink. I had to buy one separately for an extra $10. After the installation and reconnecting the ps5 cables it was recognized right away and all you had to do was format it( took seconds). The full 1tb is available for storage immediately. You can also move previous files from the ps5 hard drive to this new ssd at an incredible speed.
reviews.author: Liz

reviews.title: Great for faster storage running
reviews.comment: Works great, got tired of games running slow on my external HDD, as I was too afraid to put components in the pc, so I made sure it was external. The SSD was easy to install, the screw is small so be careful. I lost it like twice. The performance is great no issues.
reviews.author: Angel carter

reviews.title: Perfect for PS5
reviews.comment: This is the ideal internal storage to buy for your ps5, after watching a yt video it is super simple to install and has unimagineable speeds for your games and is quite a cheaper price for higher storage capabilities, this is perfect if you have trouble with ps4 games taking up space and so much more. 10/10 for me.
reviews.author: Adan H

reviews.title: Buy the correct one with HEAT SINK FOR PS5
reviews.comment: It is the correct item but if your intentions are to use this on a PS5 console please be sure to buy the one with HEAT SINK. This again is the correct item but it DOES NOT feature a heat sink.
reviews.author: Joshua Butler Jr.
